title: Factorial of n
statement: Write a function `factorial(n)` that calculates the product of numbers from 1 to n using a `for` loop. If n is 0 or 1, return 1.
prewrittenHints: In a product accumulator, what should the starting value be?
Start the product at one instead of zero so multiplication works.
Multiply the accumulated product by each number in sequence.
conceptNote: When accumulating products, initialize to 1 because multiplying by 0 results in 0.
